ftb.guhs_minigames.title: &6Minigames & Special Places
ftb.guhs_minigames.sub: Play, win and dress up chonky
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.intro_guhs_minigame:
This chapter comes after &6The Super Compass&r in &dThe Guhmension&r.

All the minigame buildings and the rare places (hide-and-guh house, library, cheese mine, floating islets, fair...) can be found with the Super Compass (Minigames or Wonders). Each row below starts at one of those buildings.

Play them in any order you like. Nyeg, so many choices! Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it earlier. The headings show what logically comes next. Tick this off and get chonky to work!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.beauty_theater.desc: Find the &dGuh Beauty Theater&r (Super Compass: Minigames). You'll know it by its front: a giant guh, and the door is its mouth!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.beauty_first.title: On the Catwalk
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.beauty_first.desc: Talk to the &dShow Guh&r on the stage and enter the Chonk Pageant. You don't have to bring anything: you borrow a model and clothes (or bring your own tame guh)! The jury holds up score cards, and above the Show Guh floats the world's &6top 3&r.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.beauty_good.title: Wahoog Stylist
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.beauty_good.desc: Score at least &665 out of 90&r points in one show. Tip: Miss Chonksley wants the theme, Mr. Glitterguh wants a complete look (head, eyes, neck and body).
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.beauty_extase.title: The Jury Goes Wild
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.beauty_extase.desc: Score &628 points or more&r in one round. The jury is standing on their cushions, clapping!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.beauty_own.title: My Guh Is a Star
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.beauty_own.desc: Let your &down tame guh&r walk the catwalk (pick 'With ...' at the Show Guh). After the show it gets its own clothes back.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.beauty_rozetten.des: Save up 16 Show Rosettes: enough for the Showstar Tiara!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.beauty_strik.title: Glitter!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.beauty_strik.desc: Buy the &dGlitter Bow&r from the Show Guh (Show Rosettes).
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.beauty_showster.des: Buy the whole Showstar outfit: the Glitter Bow, the Miss Chonky Sash and the Showstar Tiara.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_baan.title: On Your Marks, Chonk!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_baan.desc: Find the &dGuh Racetrack&r (Super Compass: Minigames > Guh Racetrack). In the pit stop, the Race Guh is waiting with a Rental Racing Guh for you.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_eerste.title: VROOM VROOM!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_eerste.desc: Ride your first guh race: 3 laps through all the glowing rings. You don't have to bring anything: the Race Guh lends you a racing guh.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_brons.title: Bronze!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_brons.desc: Finish the race within 1:45. Tip: the &6WAHOOG pads&r give you a big boost!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_goud.title: GOLD! WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_goud.desc: Finish the race within 1:12. Take the inside corners and don't miss a single pad!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_geest.title: Ghost Rider
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_geest.desc: Beat your own record while your see-through &bghost&r races along. Who's faster: you or you?
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_prijsjes.title: Trophy Cabinet
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_bril.title: Wahoog Racing Goggles
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_bril.desc: Buy &dWahoog Racing Goggles&r for your guh from the Race Guh (Race Prizes).
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_lastig.title: Racing on Hard
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_lastig.desc: The Guh Racetrack now has &aeasy&r, &emedium&r and &chard&r. Finish it on hard: a super fast but stubborn racing guh, Mika Snatchers along the track, and the silver WAHOOG pads don't work!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_jockey.title: Vroom Vroom, Guh!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.race_jockey.desc: Buy the whole jockey outfit: Jockey Cap, Striped Silk Jockey Jacket and Wahoog Racing Goggles. Only at the Race Guh!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.meppen_hal.title: Who's Popping Up There?
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.meppen_hal.desc: Find the rare &dWhack-a-Mika Hall&r (Super Compass: Minigames > Whack-a-Mika Hall). Behind the front with the giant guh face lives the Whack Guh.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.meppen_eerste.title: WHACK!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.meppen_eerste.desc: Talk to the Whack Guh and play a round of &dWhack-a-Mika&r: 60 seconds of whacking Mikas back down with the borrowed whacking hammer. Don't whack the guh!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.meppen_goud.title: Golden Whack
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.meppen_goud.desc: Whack a &6golden Mika&r: 50 points times your combo!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.meppen_500.title: Whacker
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.meppen_500.desc: Score 500 points in a round of Whack-a-Mika. Tip: 5 in a row = higher combo.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.meppen_1500.title: Mika Master
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.meppen_1500.desc: Score 1500 points in a round of Whack-a-Mika. Don't let a single Mika escape!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.meppen_2500.title: WAHOOG WHACKER
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.meppen_2500.desc: 2500 points! The Whack Guh has never seen anyone whack that fast. Are you in the &6top 3&r on the scoreboard wall yet? WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.meppen_medaille.des: Buy the Mika Whacker Medal from the Whack Guh (4 Whack Coins). It looks so good on your guh!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.meppen_pakje.title: Mika Hunter
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.meppen_pakje.desc: Buy the whole Mika Hunter outfit for your guh: the Mika Hunter Hat, the Whacking Vest with Pockets and the Mika Whacker Medal. Only for sale at the Whack Guh!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_vind.title: Saturday Night Guh Fever
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_vind.desc: Find the &dGuh Disco&r in the Guhmension (Super Compass: Minigames > Guh Disco). Follow the beat to the pink club with a guh face!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_eerste.title: First Dance
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_eerste.desc: Talk to the &5DJ Guh&r in the mouth of the big guh head and dance your first 'Simon says'. You don't need anything: just your dancing feet!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_5.title: Dancing Feet
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_5.desc: Dance a row of &e5 colors&r without a single mistake.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_10.title: Disco Guh
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_10.desc: Dance a row of &e10 colors&r without a single mistake. Listen to the tones, that helps!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_15.title: Wahoog Dance Machine
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_15.desc: Dance a row of &e15 colors&r without a single mistake. Only the chonkiest dancers make it! Whoever gets furthest gets their name up in the &etop 3&r above the stage.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_winkel.title: Glitter!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_winkel.desc: Buy a piece of the disco outfit from the DJ Guh (with Disco Coins).
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_outfit.title: Stayin' Chonky
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_outfit.desc: The whole disco outfit: Glitter Chonk Suit, Wahoog Afro Wig and Star Disco Glasses. Dress up your guh and swing!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_mambo.title: Mika Mambo Master
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_mambo.desc: Pick the hardest song at the &5DJ Guh&r, the &cMika Mambo&r, and dance &e10 colors&r in a row correctly. Watch out: soon the colors come on double beats!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_liedjes.title: The Whole Record
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_liedjes.desc: Dance at least &e3 colors&r correctly to all four of the DJ Guh's songs: the &eChonky Tango&r, &dThey Hang On My Chonk&r, the &cMika Mambo&r and the &bNyeg-Nyeg Boogie&r.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.disco_koptelefoontj: Buy the &dDisco Headphones&r from the DJ Guh and put them on your guh's ears. Now it hears the beat everywhere!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf_baan.title: Fore, Guh!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf_baan.desc: Find the rare &dGuh Mini Golf&r (Super Compass: Minigames > Guh Mini Golf). The &aGolf Guh&r lives in the clubhouse with the guh face.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf_ronde.title: Nine Holes of Chonk
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf_ronde.desc: Play a whole round of guh golf: the Golf Guh lends you a club. Hold right-click to charge the power bar, look where the ball needs to go and let go! With a good round, you'll float in the top 3 above the Golf Guh.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf_par.title: Par-Guh
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf_par.desc: Play a round on medium (par 27) or hard (par 36) at par or better. Tip: the cheese sauce costs you a penalty stroke!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf_ace.title: WAHOOG! Hole-in-One!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf_ace.desc: Sink a ball in one stroke. The Guh Path is long, but who knows...
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf_balletjes.desc: Save up 20 golf balls (the fewer strokes, the more balls).
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf_pet.title: Cap On!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf_pet.desc: Buy the Chonky Golf Cap from the Golf Guh (10 golf balls).
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf_outfit.title: Guh on the Green
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf_outfit.desc: Buy the whole golf outfit: the Chonky Golf Cap, the Guh Sun Visor and the Argyle Chonk Sweater.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.golf_lastig_par.des: Play a round on &chard&r at par (36) or better: from the red tee mats all the way at the back, past the extra slime bumpers and under the turbo guh windmill. Now that's wahoog golfing, nyeg!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.smul_festijn.title: The Chonky Food Fest
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.smul_festijn.desc: Find the &dChonky Food Fest&r (Super Compass: Minigames > Chonky Food Fest): a giant tent with a guh face, full of food. The &dMunch Guh&r is waiting inside.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.smul_eerste.title: Dig In!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.smul_eerste.desc: Talk to the Munch Guh and play a round: one whole minute of catching food with her borrowed munch bowl. You don't have to bring anything!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.smul_goud.title: Worth Its Weight in Gold
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.smul_goud.desc: Catch a &6golden munch nibble&r: 10 points and double points for a while. WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.smul_100.title: A Chonky Catch
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.smul_100.desc: Score 100 points in one round. Tip: five in a row is combo x2, ten in a row x3. And stay away from the Mika's Grease!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.smul_200.title: Munch Champion
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.smul_200.desc: Score 200 points in one round. The Munch Guh has never seen anything so chonky! Will you make the world's &6top 3&r? It floats above her head. WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.smul_slabbetje.desc: Buy the Munch Bib for your guh from the Munch Guh (Munch Coins). Messy eating allowed!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.smul_pakje.title: All Set to Munch
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.smul_pakje.desc: Buy the whole munch outfit: the Munch Bib, the Chonky Baker's Hat and the Pink Munch Apron. Only for sale at the food fest!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.vissen_vijver.title: Something Chonky's Swimming
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.vissen_vijver.desc: Find the &bGuhfish Pond&r (Super Compass: Minigames > Guhfish Pond). A pond with a jetty shaped like a guh face: that's where the &bFishing Guh&r lives.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.vissen_eerste.title: A Bite!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.vissen_eerste.desc: Join a Guhfish Contest at the Fishing Guh. You get to borrow a fishing rod: three minutes of fishing, and you can keep every fish!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.vissen_300.title: A Chonk of a Catch
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.vissen_300.desc: Score 300 points in a contest. Tip: heavy fish and rare nyeg trout are worth the most, the Mika Catfish costs points!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.vissen_soorten.desc: Catch every kind of fish from the Guhfish Pond once: Cheesefish, Chonky Bass, Guhpuffer, Pink Nyeg Trout, Mika Catfish and the Golden Guhfish.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.vissen_goud.title: Pure Gold
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.vissen_goud.desc: Catch a &6Golden Guhfish&r: legendarily rare. It's yours: every golden fish gets your name, its weight and a number. A real collector's item!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.vissen_hoedje.title: A Chonky Little Hat
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.vissen_hoedje.desc: Buy the Chonky Fishing Hat at the Fishing Guh's stall, for Fishing Tickets.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.vissen_pakje.title: Master Fishing Guh
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.vissen_pakje.desc: Buy the whole fishing outfit for your guh: the Chonky Fishing Hat, the Guhfish Vest and the Fish-on-a-Hook.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.verstop_huis.title: Who's Hiding There?
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.verstop_huis.desc: Find the rare &dHide-and-Guh House&r (Super Compass: Minigames > Hide-and-Guh House). Hidey Guh lives on the glass roof.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.verstop_makkelijk.d: Find all 5 hidden guhs on easy. Right-click a guh when you find it; listen for their soft little noises!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.verstop_medium.desc: Find all 8 hidden guhs on medium. Right-click a guh when you find it; listen for their soft little noises!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.verstop_moeilijk.de: Find all 12 hidden guhs on hard. Right-click a guh when you find it; listen for their soft little noises!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.verstop_detective.d: Buy the Guhlock Cap, the Magnifying Chonk Glass and the Detective Coat from Hidey Guh (hide-and-guh tickets).
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kermis.title: The Fair!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kermis.desc: Somewhere in the Guhmension stands the rare &dGuh Fair&r with a real roller coaster. The &6Guhmension Super Compass&r (Minigames > Guh Fair) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kermis_rit.title: WHEEEEE!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kermis_rit.desc: Hop into a sled at the station, click the buttons and start. Every lap over the finish = a &6Fair Ticket&r. Your first lap gives a prize bag!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kermis_bonnen.title: Ticket Chonker
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kermis_bonnen.desc: Save up 12 Fair Tickets (ride those laps!).
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kermis_outfit.title: Wahoog at the Fair
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kermis_outfit.desc: Buy the Wahoog Fair Hat, the Fair Jacket and the Guh Fair Bow for your guh from the Fair Guh.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.bieb_vind.title: Shhhhh!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.bieb_vind.desc: Somewhere in the Guhmension stands the very rare &dGuh Library&r: three floors full of books under a glass dome with guh ears. The &6Guhmension Super Compass&r (Wonders > Guh Library) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.bieb_eerste_boek.de: All the guh books lie open on the &dlecterns&r in the reading room: read them right away! You may take &6one&r copy of each book (button &eTake a copy&r). Take your first guh book.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.bieb_zes_boeken.des: Collect 6 different guh books from the lecterns. Sometimes there are a few in the archive chests upstairs too!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.bieb_geheim.title: Behind the Bookcase
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.bieb_geheim.desc: Somewhere on the first floor, a pink book sticks out of a bookcase a little... Find the secret room and &5The Secret Guh Book&r.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.bieb_alle_boeken.de: Collect all 14 guh books, the secret one too (and the diary from the Silent Pantry). WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.bieb_kwis.title: Guh Quiz
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.bieb_kwis.desc: Answer one of The Librarian's quiz questions correctly. He only asks about books you've read or collected, so read them carefully! Every correct answer (the first time) = a &6Book Token&r.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.bieb_pakje.title: Professor Guh
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.bieb_pakje.desc: Buy the scholar outfit for your guh from The Librarian (only for sale there!): the Scholar's Specs, the Bookworm Vest and the Scholar's Beret, with Book Tokens.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kaasmijn_find.title: Mind Your Head!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kaasmijn_find.desc: Somewhere deep in the Guhmension stands a giant guh head wearing a yellow hard hat. Walk in through its mouth: that's the &6Cheese Mine&r! Very rare: use the Super Compass (Adventure).
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kaasmijn_leen.title: A Borrowed Pickaxe
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kaasmijn_leen.desc: Talk to the &dMiner Guh&r inside the head. He lends you a pickaxe, so you don't have to bring anything. Nyeg, do give it back though!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kaasmijn_brok.title: Cheese from the Rocks
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kaasmijn_brok.desc: Mine the yellow &6Cheese Veins&r in the cheese tunnels: you won't find them anywhere but here in the Cheese Mine! Mined-out veins grow back all by themselves.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kaasmijn_rit.title: The Cheese Express
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kaasmijn_rit.desc: Press a minecart dispenser, hop in and ride laps through the cheese tunnels for half a minute. WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kaasmijn_goud.title: Gouda as Gold
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kaasmijn_goud.desc: Deep in the mine, in the dark deepslate, a &6Golden Cheese Vein&r sometimes glitters. Take the WAHOOG Jump down!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kaasmijn_kluis.desc: In the treasure room, the Cheese Vault sits in the mouth of a golden guh. For 2 Gold Cheese it opens up...
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.kaasmijn_pakje.desc: Buy the Miner Guh Helmet (with a little lamp!), the Cheese Mine Overalls and the Dusty Hanky from the Miner Guh (only he sells them) and put them on your guh. WAHOOG, what a pro!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.eilanden_vind.title: Floating Guh Islets
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.eilanden_vind.desc: High up in the sky of the Guhmension float the &bFloating Guh Islets&r. Very rare! The &dGuhmension Super Compass&r (Wonders > Floating Guh Islets) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.eilanden_lift.title: WAHOOG, Up We Go!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.eilanden_lift.desc: Under the islets lies a square with a guh face. Stand on the &bCloud Lift&r (the nose!): it blows you up into the sky. To get down, float on the blue Cloud Lift at the end of the gangplank.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.eilanden_zien.title: What a Little Cloud!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.eilanden_zien.desc: On the big island, in a nest of wool, lives the &bCloud Guh&r: the only one in the whole Guhmension. Stand next to it for its Guhdex page.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.eilanden_gevoerd.de: The Cloud Guh only trusts you once it's chonky enough: feed it at least &68 cheese nibbles&r.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.eilanden_tem.title: On Cloud Nine
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.eilanden_tem.desc: Keep feeding the Cloud Guh until it's yours. A tamed Cloud Guh catches you when you fall!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.eilanden_pakje.desc: Undress your tamed Cloud Guh in its wardrobe: the &bCloud Hat&r and the &bCloud Collar&r are now yours (and your other guhs').
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.eilanden_opgevangen: Jump off something (at least 6 blocks) while your tamed Cloud Guh is nearby. Poof: it catches you!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.eilanden_schat.desc: In the mouth of the Guh Rock (the giant guh head drooling cheese sauce) and on the highest little cloud there's a treasure chest. Look for &bCloud Cotton Candy&r: with it you float gently down anywhere.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.klassiekers_niveaus: At the &dChonk Pageant&r, &dWhack-a-Mika&r, &dguh golf&r, the &dChonky Food Fest&r and the &dGuhfish Contest&r you now pick how hard it is yourself: three buttons above the play button. &aEasy&r is nice and relaxed, &emedium&r is like always and &chard&r... is really hard, but you get half again as much reward! Every level has its own scoreboard.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.klassiekers_beauty_: Walk a whole show on &chard&r: only 30 seconds to dress your model, and a strict jury. Tip: pick pieces that really fit the theme, and preferably a set!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.klassiekers_meppen_: Play Whack-a-Mika on &chard&r: the Mikas are lightning fast and there are lots of guhs in between. Don't whack the guhs, okay!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.klassiekers_golf_la: Play all 9 holes on &chard&r: 6 strokes per hole and penalty strokes, from the red tee mats all the way at the back, past extra slime bumpers and under a turbo guh windmill.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.klassiekers_smul_la: Score points at the food fest on &chard&r: the food drops like a rocket and it's raining Mika's Grease. Will your guh still be wahoog?
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.klassiekers_vissen_: Fish a whole contest on &chard&r: when you get a bite you only have half a second, and heavy fish sometimes wriggle off your hook.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.klassiekers_kampioe: Play all five classics on &chard&r. Then you're the most wahoog guh in the Guhmension! WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.sjoelen_huisje.desc: In the &dGuh Meadows&r there's sometimes a wooden house with a giant shuffleboard for a roof and a guh face on the front: the &6Shuffle House&r (Super Compass: Minigames). &6Granny Nyegshuffle&r lives inside.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.sjoelen_beurt.title: Twenty Pucks
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.sjoelen_beurt.desc: Talk to Granny Nyegshuffle and shuffle a whole turn. Hold right-click: the power bar goes up and down, and between Granny's two little lines is just right. Look where the puck needs to go and let go!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.sjoelen_zestig.desc: Shuffle 60 points or more. Tip: try to get the same number of pucks in every gate, because every set (2-3-4-1) is twenty points!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.sjoelen_honderd.des: The full 100 points: five pucks in every gate. Granny Nyegshuffle has only seen that once before...
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.sjoelen_petje.title: Cap On!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.sjoelen_petje.desc: Buy the Shuffle Cap from Granny Nyegshuffle (4 Shuffle Pucks): a flat little cap, just like a shuffle puck.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.sjoelen_pakje.title: Knitted by Granny
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.sjoelen_pakje.desc: Collect the whole shuffle outfit: the Shuffle Cap, the warm Shuffle Vest and the Shuffle Brooch.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.sjoelen_opoe.title: A Cup of Tea with Granny
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.sjoelen_opoe.desc: Add Granny Nyegshuffle to your Guhdex (get close enough).
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.doolhof_vinden.desc: In the &dGuh Fields&r stands an enormous hedge maze with a lookout guh in the middle. The Super Compass (Minigames) shows the way. Say hello to &aMr. Chonkwiggle&r at his kiosk on the square.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.doolhof_makkelijk.d: Pick &aeasy&r: Mr. Chonkwiggle grows a new maze. Find the eight stolen cheese nibbles (they float, glittering, above the hedges, and at the bottom of your screen you can see how many are still hidden) and run to the exit in the north. Watch out for the slow Hedge Mika!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.doolhof_medium.desc: Beat the &emedium&r maze: twelve nibbles and two Hedge Mikas that snatch one back if they tag you.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.doolhof_lastig.desc: The &chard&r maze: the whole hedge field, sixteen nibbles, three fast Mikas and fake nibbles in the dead ends (those cost time!). Real nibbles glitter a little...
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.doolhof_ongepikt.de: Beat a medium or hard maze without a Mika snatching even one nibble.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.doolhof_pakje.title: Off Exploring
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.doolhof_pakje.desc: Buy the Explorer's Hat, the Little Maze Compass and the Explorer's Backpack from Mr. Chonkwiggle (maze nibbles) and unlock them for your guhs.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.katapult_kasteel.de: On the &dChonk Cliffs&r there's sometimes a cheerful guh castle with a catapult on the wall, facing a wonky Mika Fort (Super Compass: Minigames). &6Captain Floopguh&r stands on the wall.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.katapult_ronde.desc: Pick a level at the Captain and knock twelve Mika Forts flat. Aim, hold right-click and let go: FLOOP! Mikas run off giggling (nobody gets hurt) and the stolen cheese nibbles are free again.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.katapult_sterren.de: Get three stars on one fort: all Mikas gone, all nibble chests open, and a fluffball left over. Tip: hit the thin posts at the bottom!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.katapult_lastig.des: Play a whole round on &chard&r: three fluffballs per fort, and it's windy. Keep an eye on the wind arrows at the bottom of your screen!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.katapult_alle_sterr: Get all 36 stars in one round. That'll leave Captain Floopguh totally speechless.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.katapult_pakje.desc: Collect the whole catapult outfit from the Captain: the Catapult Helmet, the Catapult Belt and the Fluffball Earrings.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.katapult_kapitein.d: Add Captain Floopguh to your Guhdex (get close enough).
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.knabbelspelen_vinde: In the &dGuh Meadows&r and the &dPink Puffs&r there's sometimes a big circus tent with two guh ears for tent peaks: &6The Nibble Games&r. Say hello to &aCoach Wahoogaroo&r in the middle of the ring.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.knabbelspelen_spele: Pick an event at Coach Wahoogaroo and join in. Bring your friends: up to four guhs play at once, each in their own lane!
Pin the Tail on the Guh: blindfold on, spin around three times, then put the little tail in the right spot. Score 950 points or more!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.knabbelspelen_samen: Play The Nibble Games with at least one friend at the same time. Whoever opens it waits a moment for the others.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.knabbelspelen_zeska: All six events in a row: Nibble Bobbing, Sack Race, Mika Can Toss, Egg-and-Spoon Race, Nail Plopping and Pin the Tail on the Guh. Every event is 0 to 1000 points!
Score 5000 points or more in The Great Hexathlon. The score table at Coach Wahoogaroo tells you how it counts.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.knabbelspelen_pakje: Buy the Sports Sweatband, the Referee Whistle and the Nibble Games Jersey from Coach Wahoogaroo (Games Ribbons) and unlock them for your guhs.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.elftocht_vinden.des: Somewhere in an ice-cold &bGuh Polder&r lies a frozen canal past eleven villages: the &6Eleven Guhtowns Tour&r! The Super Compass (Minigames tab) shows you the way.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.elftocht_start.desc: Talk to &6Skate Master Guhglide&r in Guhwarden and start the tour. Hold on to the guh skates: on the ice you glide super wahoog!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.elftocht_uit.title: Eleven Guhtowns Cross
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.elftocht_uit.desc: Get a stamp from every &6Stamp Guh&r, in the right order (Snuh first, Guhwarden last), and skate the whole tour to the end. Every tour gives &612 Town Stamps&r (up to 8 extra if you're fast), and your first time you get the &6Eleven Guhtowns Cross&r and 5 extra Town Stamps!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.elftocht_snel.title: Super Wahoog
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.elftocht_snel.desc: Skate the Eleven Guhtowns Tour in under 3:40. Tip: Hot Chocochonk and pea soup give a boost, and sprinting on the ice is fastest! That fast, you get 8 extra Town Stamps.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.elftocht_kleding.de: Buy the Pom-Pom Skating Hat, the Woolly Skating Sweater, the Orange Skating Scarf and the Fluffy Earmuffs from Skate Master Guhglide, and unlock them for your guhs.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.circuit_vinden.desc: Find &dThe Guh Circuit&r in the Guh Fields or the Cheese Flats (Super Compass: Minigames > Guh Circuit). In the Pit Palace, Coach Wahoog-Vroom is waiting with a Rental Racing Guh for you.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.circuit_eerste.desc: Ride your first race on the Guh Circuit. Pick a track and a level at Coach Wahoog-Vroom: you don't have to bring anything.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.circuit_regenboog.d: Finish &dRainbow Road&r. Ride through the rainbow rings for a WAHOOG boost and jump over the gaps in the road!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.circuit_vads.title: Wheeee, the Loop!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.circuit_vads.desc: Finish the &6Chonk Track&r: slippery cheese sauce, bouncy mushrooms and the Chonk Loop. Just keep running!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.circuit_kaasberg.de: Finish the &bCheese Mountain Track&r. Dodge the Mikas' rolling cheese nibbles on the Nibble Slope!
Finish all three tracks of the Guh Circuit.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.circuit_lastig.desc: Ride a race on &chard&r: a super fast but stubborn racing guh, lots of Mika Snatchers, and the silver WAHOOG pads don't work.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.circuit_gouden_gees: Beat the &6golden ghost&r (the world's track record rides along with you) or race a &6gold-medal time&r on a track of the Guh Circuit. Are you as fast as the legend?
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.circuit_kleding.des: Buy the whole circuit outfit from Coach Wahoog-Vroom: Circuit Helmet, Wahoog Racing Suit and Checkered Flag Cape. Only there!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.gids_ontdekker.desc: Six brand-new buildings full of games: the &6Shuffle House&r, the &2Guh Maze&r, the &cNibble Catapult&r, the &9Nibble Games&r, the &bEleven Guhtowns Tour&r and the &dGuh Circuit&r. Pick them in your Super Compass (Minigames tab) and take a peek inside. Your Guhdex (Minigames tab) shows which ones you've found already!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.gids_wereldreiziger: A real guh tourist visits ALL the minigame buildings: the classics, Snuggledale and The Great Guh Games. The Guhdex (Minigames tab) shows with a tick where you've been. Still missing one? Nyeg! The Super Compass will help you.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.guhpolder_vind.desc: Somewhere in the Guhmension lies an ice-cold, flat &bGuh Polder&r: frosty grass, pollard willows, frozen ditches and little snow guhs. This is where the &bEleven Guhtowns Tour&r is skated! Bring a warm scarf, nyeg.
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.guhpolder_pinguh.de: A third of the wild guhs in the polder are &bPinguhs&r: classic, emperor or a gray fluffy chick. Tame one with cheese nibbles. It slides on its tummy over the ice, and during the Eleven Guhtowns Tour it slides right along with you!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.guhpolder_ijsbloemp: Pick three &bguh ice flowers&r: see-through blue flowers with a teeny tiny guh face. They give light blue dye!
Find a &bGuh Windmill&r in the polder or make one yourself (wool, sticks, a cheese nibble and planks). Its sails turn all day long, and even faster when it snows!
ftb.guhs_minigames.q.guhpolder_meel.desc: Put Nibble Grain in a Guh Windmill (right-click) and get &eNibble Flour&r out of it. In the baker's Nibble Oven, Nibble Flour bakes twice as much. WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.title: &dSnuggledale
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.intro_guhs_knuffel:
This chapter comes after &6The Super Compass&r in &dThe Guhmension&r: pick the &dCozy&r category and it points you to &dSnuggledale&r.

Help Mayor Chonkworth with the Great Cozyfest. Every building on the square (and beyond) has its own row below. And go look up &dCoco&r some time!

Everything is cozy. Nothing is locked: every quest ticks itself off as soon as you've done it, even if you did it earlier. The headings show what logically comes next. Tick this off and get chonky to work!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffeldal_dal.des: Somewhere in the Guhmension lies a small, soft pink valley full of &dSnuggle Grass&r, Fluffy Trees and Guh Mushrooms: &dSnuggledale&r. The Super Compass (Cozy category) shows the way to the town in the middle.
In the middle of every Snuggledale lies a cozy town: a square with a big guh fountain, guh houses with residents, Grandpa Guh by the campfire and the party buffet. WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffeldal_burgeme: Talk to &dMayor Chonkworth&r on his front steps. The Great Cozyfest is coming... but nothing's ready, nyeg! He gives you a list of six party chores.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffeldal_feestta: Party chore: Party Cake. Baker Crusty bakes it in the Nibble Bakery, on the north side of the square. Then bring it to the mayor.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffeldal_theeser: Party chore: tea set. Mrs. Teaspoon lends it out after a snug tea party in the Nibble Tea House (east side). Then bring it to the mayor.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffeldal_feestka: Party chore: party hairdos. Curly the Barber cuts them during a festive Salon Show in Snip & Chonk (south side). Then bring them to the mayor.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffeldal_feestsl: Party chore: party garlands. Miss Snuggles' baby guhs craft them in the Snuggle Daycare (west side). Then bring them to the mayor.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffeldal_feestbl: Party chore: party flowers. Grow little guh flowers in your own garden and make a party bouquet out of them. Then bring it to the mayor.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffeldal_sterren: Party chore: Star Lanterns. Professor Twinkle gives them to you when you connect a constellation in the Guh Observatory. Then bring them to the mayor.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffeldal_kruimel: On the way to the mayor, a &6Crumb Mika&r snatches the Party Cake, the tea set or the garlands! Follow the trail of crumbs and lure it away with a treat (cheese nibbles or pastries). It never fights: it only giggles.
Bring all six party chores to Mayor Chonkworth. Then the Great Cozyfest begins at the party buffet, and all your tame guhs come to munch! You become &dSnuggle Mayor&r and get the Cozy Certificate and the Mayor's Sash.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffeldal_seizoen: After the Great Cozyfest, the mayor throws a season party every season with a few new party chores. Celebrate one!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffeldal_pluisgu: &dFluffguhs&r live in Snuggledale: extra fluffy pink guhs with a little quiff. Tame one with cheese nibbles!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffeldal_seizoen: Every season there's something different to do in Snuggledale: braiding blossom wreaths (spring), wearing sun hats (summer), jumping in Leaf Piles (fall) and building Snowman Guhs (winter). Fill the Season Scrapbook in your Guhdex!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffeldal_cocotje: &dCoco&r lives in a little house with long droopy ears. She's lost a few things... Do you know where they are?
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffeldal_vriendj: Talk to all six residents of the guh houses in the town (right-click with an empty hand). They're in your Guhdex under Cozy!
Add Mayor Chonkworth, Coco, a Crumb Mika and a Fluffguh to your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.bakkerij_korstje.d: On the north side of the square in Snuggledale stands an enormous cheese nibble loaf with a guh face: the &6Nibble Bakery&r! Say hello to &6Baker Crusty&r (he's in your Guhdex too).
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.bakkerij_spelen.de: Talk to Baker Crusty and press &6Bake!&r For two whole minutes, you're the baker: customers come in with a little thought cloud above their heads, and that's what they want.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.bakkerij_eerste.de: Click a Nibble Oven, pick dough, shape and topping, slide it into the oven and take it out when the needle is in the orange. Then right-click the customer. WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.bakkerij_combo.des: Make six customers in a row happy without burning anything or keeping anyone waiting.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.bakkerij_100.title: Little Baker
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.bakkerij_100.desc: Score 100 points in one baking round.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.bakkerij_250.title: Big Baker
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.bakkerij_250.desc: Score 250 points in one baking round. You'll surely be in the High Scores of your Guhdex!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.bakkerij_perfect.d: Take something out of the oven exactly when the needle is right in the middle of the orange.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.bakkerij_oven.desc: Buy a &6Nibble Oven&r from Crusty (or make one) and bake yourself: grain or wheat, milk, eggs, sugar... With goodies from the Guh Farm and your gardens you bake an extra one!
Bake all twelve recipes good or perfect: they go into the Recipe Book in your Guhdex (Cozy tab).
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.bakkerij_pakje.des: Buy the Little Baker's Hat, the Little Baker's Apron and the Flour Bow in Crusty's shop.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.bakkerij_munten.de: Save up 10 Bake Coins. You can also use them for a go on the Claw Machine!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.creche_juf.title: Miss Snuggles
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.creche_juf.desc: On the west side of the Snuggledale square sits a giant baby guh with a pacifier: the &dSnuggle Daycare&r. Walk in between its little feet and talk to &dMiss Snuggles&r.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.creche_verzorgen.d: Do the care round: give three baby guhs a baby bottle and a clean diaper, tuck them in with a Snuggle Blankie and sing a lullaby (tap along to the beat!).
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.creche_terugbrenge: Play the game: the baby guhs crawl out of their cradles. Right-click one to pick it up and bring it back to an empty cradle. The faster, the more points!
Bring back at least 8 baby guhs in one game without Miss Snuggles having to fetch a single one herself.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.creche_slaapliedje: Learn all four of Miss Snuggles' lullabies (every care round she teaches you a new song). They're in your Guhdex, Cozy tab.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.creche_babykleertj: Buy a Baby Romper for your tame guh from Miss Snuggles. So cute, WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.creche_wiegje.desc: Make or buy a Guh Cradle. Rock it (right-click) and your baby guhs grow up a little.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.creche_guhdex.desc: Stand right next to Miss Snuggles, and she'll be in your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.theehuis_theelepel: On the east side of the Snuggledale square stands a giant teapot with a guh head for a lid: the &dNibble Tea House&r. Talk to &dMrs. Teaspoon&r.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.theehuis_thee_zett: Put something tasty in a little teapot (right-click): cheese nibbles make Nibble Tea. With Cheese Milk, Tea Herb or little guh flowers you get other kinds of tea.
Bring your tame guhs and hold a tea party. They sit down at the tea table and chat; pour tea and serve something tasty when they want it. A snug table makes everyone &dSnug&r!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.theehuis_zelfgebak: Serve pastries from the Nibble Bakery at a tea party. That makes guhs extra happy!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.theehuis_theesoort: Make or drink all four kinds of tea: Nibble Tea, Cheese Milk Tea, Herb Tea and Guh Flower Tea. They're in your Guhdex (Cozy tab).
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.theehuis_theemutsj: After your first snug tea party, Mrs. Teaspoon gives you a Tea Cozy Hat. Put it on your guh!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.theehuis_guhdex.de: Stand right next to Mrs. Teaspoon, and she'll be in your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kapper_krulletje.d: On the square of Snuggledale town there's a hair salon with a huge pink mop of curls for a roof: &dSnip & Chonk&r. Talk to &dCurly the Barber&r: he lends you a pair of Barber Scissors.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kapper_eerste_klan: Give a customer in the Salon Show the right hairstyle. First wash 3x, then cut, dye and blow-dry!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kapper_eerste_show: Finish a whole Salon Show (or stop whenever you like). You get Curl Coins for your points.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kapper_show.title: Wahoog Salon Show
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kapper_show.desc: Score at least &e120 points&r in a Salon Show. Cutting fast and precisely, and perfect hairstyles in a row, give you a combo! The best barbers are in the &etop 3&r above the show chair.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kapper_eigen_guh.t: My Guh Goes to the Barber
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kapper_eigen_guh.d: Buy a hairstyle from Curly the Barber (or win one) and right-click your own tame guh: a new hairstyle that stays! With a hairstyle on, you can dye it too.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kapper_haarverf.de: Dye your tame guh's hair with Hair Dye (make it with a glass bottle, a dye and a cheese nibble).
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kapper_cape.title: Barber Cape
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kapper_cape.desc: Buy the Barber Cape from Curly the Barber (for Curl Coins). Buying it is enough; you may put it on, it makes your guh extra chonky chic.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kapper_collectie.d: Fill the whole Hairstyle Collection in the Guhdex (Cozy): all 8 hairstyles and all 8 hair dyes. They count when you give them to your own guh, or when you cut a customer's hair perfectly.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kapper_guhdex.desc: Add Curly the Barber to your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kapper_klanten.des: Send &e30 customers&r home happy from Curly the Barber's Salon Shows. Every guh that waddles out of the salon with a wahoog hairdo counts. So chonky, so fresh!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.boerderij_vind.des: Somewhere in the Guh Meadows or the Cheese Flats stands a farm with barns shaped like giant animals: the &dGuh Farm&r. The Super Compass (Cozy category) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.boerderij_hooibaal: Talk to &dFarmer Haybale&r in the cow barn (the giant cow!). She has a little chore for you every day.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.boerderij_dieren.d: Add the Guh Lamb, the Nibble Chick, the Guh Cow and Farmer Haybale to your Guhdex: stand right next to them.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.boerderij_verzorgd: Pet a farm animal (empty hand), brush it (Guh Brush) or feed it (Nibble Feed). Two out of three in one day and it's &dsuper happy&r!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.boerderij_pluiswol: A happy Guh Lamb drops a tuft of &fFluff Wool&r.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.boerderij_knabbele: A happy Nibble Chick lays a &eNibble Egg&r in the nearest chicken nest. Grab it!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.boerderij_kaasmelk: Make a Guh Cow happy and hold an empty bottle next to it: &eCheese Milk&r! Moo!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.boerderij_alles.de: Get all three farm products from your own happy animals. The baker and the tea house love them!
Make a &dGuh Feeding Trough&r and put Nibble Feed in it. Hungry animals nearby will eat from it all by themselves.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.boerderij_klusje.d: Do the chore of the day for Farmer Haybale.
Do seven chores for Farmer Haybale (one per day). Then you get her Farm Hat in your Guhdex (Cozy)!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.tuintjes_pot.title: A Garden of Your Own
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.tuintjes_pot.desc: Make a &dGuh Flower Pot&r (three terracotta) or a &dGuh Veggie Planter&r, or buy one from Farmer Haybale.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.tuintjes_zaadjes.d: You get seeds from Farmer Haybale, in her farm chest, or from your own harvest. You can also make Nibble Seeds from cheese nibbles and wheat seeds.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.tuintjes_gieter.de: With a &bGuh Watering Can&r you water your gardens (3 x 3 at once). Watered plants grow much faster! Empty? Right-click on water.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.tuintjes_oogst.des: Right-click a ripe plant to harvest it. The plant stays put and grows back!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.tuintjes_graan.des: Harvest Nibble Grain: for the baker's dough (and for Nibble Feed).
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.tuintjes_theekruid: Harvest Tea Herb: Mrs. Teaspoon makes tea with it.
Harvest little guh flowers: pink flowers with a little face.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.tuintjes_guhs.desc: Tame guhs that wander around near your gardens water them all by themselves (just look at the little droplets!). Let your tame guhs water a plant 10 times together: WAHOOG, those watering guhs!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.tuintjes_zang.desc: Plants grow from music! Let a guh sing (the Sing emote, or the choir) right next to your gardens, until a plant has grown from it 5 times. After a song, a plant does need a little rest: keep watering too!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.tuintjes_feestboek: Make a party bouquet out of five little guh flowers. Mayor Chonkworth wants one for the Great Cozyfest!
Fill the Garden Book in your Guhdex (Cozy tab): plant and harvest all three guh plants.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.sterrenwacht_gevon: High up on the &dGuh Peaks&r and the &dChonk Cliffs&r stands an observatory with a dome that looks like a guh head, and a giant telescope. The Super Compass (Cozy category) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.sterrenwacht_sterr: Talk to &dProfessor Twinkle&r in the observatory. He knows everything about the guh constellations.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.sterrenwacht_eerst: Look through a &dGuh Telescope&r at night. Somewhere among the stars hides a guh constellation: click a star and then the next one to draw the lines. Found it? Wishing Stars!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.sterrenwacht_zes.d: Put six guh constellations in your Star Atlas (Guhdex, Cozy tab). You can find at most three per night.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.sterrenwacht_zeldz: During a &bStar Shower&r you can see three rare constellations: The Golden Guh, The Falling Nibble and The Guh Crown. Find one!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.sterrenwacht_atlas: Find all fifteen guh constellations. WAHOOG, a real stargazer!
Hold a &dWishing Star&r and right-click: your wish comes true! (Usually cheese nibbles, nyeg.)
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.sterrenwacht_pakje: Buy the Stargazer Hat and the Star Cape from Professor Twinkle (for Wishing Stars) and put them on your guh.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.sterrenwacht_guhde: Add Professor Twinkle to your Guhdex (get close enough).
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.ballon_gevonden.de: On the &dGuh Fields&r and the &dPink Puffs&r there's sometimes a Balloon Festival, full of hot-air balloons shaped like guh heads. The Super Compass (Cozy category) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.ballon_wolkje.desc: Talk to &dCaptain Cloudy&r at his kiosk next to the balloon dock. He'll take you up into the sky right away!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.ballon_eerste_vluc: Take a balloon flight. You don't have to steer: look around and listen to the Captain. After landing you get stamps and Balloon Coins.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.ballon_stempelkaar: There are four routes with two views each. Collect all eight stamps on your Balloon Stamp Card (Guhdex, Cozy tab).
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.ballon_pakje.title: Ready for the Sky
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.ballon_pakje.desc: Buy the Balloon Cap and the Balloon Goggles from Captain Cloudy (sneak + talk: his little shop) and put them on your guh.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.ballon_mini.title: A Little Balloon for Home
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.ballon_mini.desc: A Mini Hot-Air Balloon for your house: buy one from the Captain or make it yourself from wool, paper and string.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.ballon_guhdex.desc: Add Captain Cloudy to your Guhdex (get close enough).
In &dSnuggledale&r and on the &dGuh Meadows&r there are little campsites: a campfire, little guh tents and Grandpa Guh. The Super Compass (Cozy category) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kamperen_opa.title: Grandpa Guh
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kamperen_opa.desc: Talk to &dGrandpa Guh&r, at a campsite or on his bench in Snuggledale.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kamperen_verhaal.d: Come to the campfire in the evening or at night and talk to Grandpa Guh: he'll tell a story. Stay close until it's over!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kamperen_bundel.de: Grandpa Guh knows twelve stories and tells one per night. Collect them all in your Story Collection (Guhdex, Cozy tab).
Sleep a whole night in a &dGuh Sleeping Bag&r (no bed needed!). You wake up well-rested.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kamperen_pyjama.de: At night, guhs wear their pajamas by the campfire. Listen to a story with at least five guhs in pajamas around you!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kamperen_guhdex.de: Add Grandpa Guh to your Guhdex (get close enough).
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.kamperen_marshmall: In the evening, roast a &dMarshmallow Nibble&r over a burning campfire (right-click the fire with the marshmallow in your hand). Mmm! The guhs nearby come and sit with you, all snug.
By the Guh Sea stands a big bathhouse shaped like a guh head, with three big slides: the &bSnuggle Pool&r. The Super Compass (Cozy category) shows the way.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffelbad_badmees: In the pool hall, inside the guh head, sits &bLifeguard Bubbles&r with his whistle. Tweeet! Talk to him and add him to your Guhdex.
Wash your own tame guh in a &dGuh Washtub&r: Guh Shampoo on, scrub until it foams, shower and blow-dry. Then it shines for a whole day! (Lifeguard Bubbles gives you your first shampoo and hair dryer.)
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffelbad_roze_tr: Slide through the two funnels with a guh face: spin round and round, and then FLOMP into the pink foam.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffelbad_glimtun: Slide through the dark tube full of glowing little stars, round and round the Star Guh's tower.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffelbad_grote_p: Out of the Giant Guh's mouth, down its tongue and then through the air into the pool. SPLASH!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffelbad_kampioe: Go down all three slides of the Snuggle Pool.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffelbad_eendjes: Grab 100 Rubber Duckies in total on the slides (steer with A and D).
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffelbad_verzame: Twelve special Rubber Duckies float on the slides, from the Fluff Ducky to the Golden Ducky. Find them all (they're in your Guhdex, under Cozy).
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.knuffelbad_badpakj: Buy the &bSwim Cap&r and the &dBathrobe&r from Lifeguard Bubbles. Buying them is enough; put them on your guh and it waddles to the pool extra cozy and wahoog.
Score 250 points on one slide (duckies in a combo count extra!).
In the guh villages and Snuggledale, the guhs live a real guh day. In the morning: a great big yawn and a stretchy-stretch. Have a look early in the morning!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.wereldleven_gezwaa: During the day, guhs wave at you when you walk by, your own tame guhs too (when they're roaming free).
In the afternoon the guhs take a nap: in a Guh Nest, or curled up on the spot in a little nest. Zzz... don't wake them up, nyeg!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.wereldleven_kampvu: In the evening the guhs sit around the campfire. Give one a &dMarshmallow Nibble&r (stick + sugar + cheese nibble): it roasts it and munches it right up!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.wereldleven_ijscog: Hear a little bell? That's &dJingles the Ice Cream Guh&r on his ice cream bike! He swings by every now and then in the Guhmension (on the Snuggledale square too) and the guhs run after him.
Buy a Cheese Ice Cream from Jingles the Ice Cream Guh and eat it, or give it to a guh: it gets an ice cream hat, blushies or starts floating!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.wereldleven_alle_i: Taste all seven Cheese Ice Creams. Four of them are only around in their own season: blossom (spring), sunshine (summer), apple pie (fall) and snow (winter).
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.wereldleven_guhdex: Ice Cream Guh in the Guhdex
Stand close to Jingles the Ice Cream Guh: then he goes into your Guhdex.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.wereldleven_xylofo: Make a &dGuh Xylophone&r: eight colored bars, from do to do.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.wereldleven_koortj: Play a song from the Songbook on the Guh Xylophone while there are guhs nearby: they all sing along! (Gardens nearby grow from it too.)
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.wereldleven_fluitj: With the &dGuh Whistle&r you whistle your last song wherever you like, and the guhs sing along.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.wereldleven_liedje: Play all six songs: then you get the Choir Bow! WAHOOG!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.wereldleven_grijpm: At the Guh Fair and under the arcade of Snuggledale stands a &dClaw Machine&r. One ticket (a Fair Ticket or a coin from a minigame), and you steer the claw yourself! Every plushie also gives you a Fair Ticket back.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.wereldleven_knuffe: Put down a Guh Plushie: your tame guhs (the ones roaming free) come over now and then to give it a big cuddle.
Collect all 22 Guh Plushies, the rare Glitter Guh Plushie too. Your Plushie Shelf is in your Guhdex (Cozy tab).
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.beroepen_straat.de: On the east side of &dSnuggledale town&r runs &6Career Street&r: the Fire Station (with a roof like a fire helmet), the little Police Station (with a roof like a police cap) and the little Pharmacy (with a green cross). Say hello to Fire Chief Splashguh!
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.beroepen_brandweer: Help &6Fire Chief Splashguh&r: hose out all the way-too-chonky marshmallow fires on the training ground with the guh fire hose (hold right-click), and then get Climby down from the tall tree (using the ladder). You get the Firefighter Helmet and the Firefighter Jacket.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.beroepen_vahoegsma: The little Police Station stands in the middle of Career Street, with a blue lamp by the door. Say hello to &6Inspector Wahoogsby&r.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.beroepen_politie.t: The Case of the Nibble Thief
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.beroepen_politie.d: The town's nibble vault is empty! Follow the pink paw prints from the vault, find the bag of cheese nibbles (the Nibble Thief runs off giggling) and tell Wahoogsby. You get the Police Cap and the Police Uniform.
In the little Pharmacy with the green cross, &6Doctor Sniffleguh&r stands behind the counter. Achoo!
Pick 3 sniffle herbs in the herb garden, mix them with Cheese Milk in the mixing cauldron and give the Cheese Milk Potion to Sniffles. You get the Doctor's Coat and the Stethoscope.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.beroepen_bob.title: Bob the Guhbuilder
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.beroepen_bob.desc: In some &dguh villages&r (Super Compass: Homes) stands a half-built house with a little crane next to it. That's where &6Bob the Guhbuilder&r works. Can we fix it?
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.beroepen_bouw.desc: Bring Bob 16 planks and 8 cheese nibbles (his lunch), then climb onto the roof and lay the roof tiles on all the see-through roof spots. You get the Hard Hat and the Safety Vest.
ftb.guhs_knuffeldal.q.beroepen_alle.desc: Learn all four careers. Which hat will you wear today?
